subject.title: [Feature]: Allow telegram groups by creating allowList of users

question: What exact fail-closed contract should a bundled Telegram `groupPolicy: "members"` use for group messages and native commands?
rationale: The code can implement several plausible membership-check shapes, but the safe behavior on Telegram API uncertainty and all-member trust must be a maintainer/security choice.

options.title: Define and implement fail-closed members policy
options.body: Land a bundled Telegram-only policy that accepts only groups whose current members can be verified against explicit numeric trusted IDs, with docs and tests covering inbound messages, native commands, audit, and config schema.

options.title: Keep allowlist-only bundled policy
options.body: Leave current core behavior unchanged and document the community chat-only-trigger plugin as a workaround for deployments that want a softer group mode.

options.title: Move experimentation to plugin API design
options.body: Keep this issue open as a plugin/API extension discussion until Telegram authorization hooks can express the policy outside bundled core.

recommendation.title: Define and implement fail-closed members policy
recommendation.body: Land a bundled Telegram-only policy that accepts only groups whose current members can be verified against explicit numeric trusted IDs, with docs and tests covering inbound messages, native commands, audit, and config schema.
